integrity: The arbitrary-field proof is symbolic and self-contained. Finite computations are supplementary checks only and are not used to infer the general theorem. A residual originality risk from older weak-automorphism terminology is explicitly recorded.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the regular strong strictly elementary full-matrix grading and to k-algebra automorphisms. It does not treat repeated tuple entries, partial-action gradings, or semilinear field automorphisms. Older crossed-product literature already identifies the componentwise coordinate-permutation subgroup; the new claim is the full component-permuting group and Weyl quotient.
title: Symmetry of the regular strong elementary matrix grading
